description: ServiceNow MCP server: tools over the ServiceNow REST surface with multi-instance profiles, plan-and-apply write safety and a two-axis policy model.
rules: Tool names follow servicenow_<verb>_<noun>; docs/tools/<package>.md lists each tool's parameters and output.
Write tools return a non-mutating plan preview unless called with apply: true (or SN_WRITE_MODE=apply).
Only the core profile is on by default; other packages are enabled with SN_TOOL_PACKAGES or servicenow_enable_package.
Configure credentials with npx servicenow-mcp-ai init and diagnose with npx servicenow-mcp-ai doctor.
